criteria_verification.notes: Dedup map implementation verified in slack_notifier.py lines 173, 194-210, 381-399. Correctly keys stream events as (event_type, build_id, stage_label or '') and intake events as ('build_queued', correlation_id). Test coverage: TestQueuedIntakeDedupKeyedOnCorrelationId with independent test verification.

Monotonic clock implementation verified using _monotonic alias (line 75) in eviction logic (lines 401-414). Eviction happens on every notify() call before dedup check. Test coverage: TestDedupTtlExpiry with controlled monotonic clock mocking. Independent tests confirm TTL behavior.

Dedup logic in notify() (lines 199-207) drops duplicates within TTL window with debug log, preventing second post. Test coverage: TestDuplicateTerminalEnvelopePostsOnce verifies exactly one chat.postMessage call for duplicate notification. Independent tests passed.

Dedup keys include build_id (lines 397-399) ensuring distinct build_ids create separate keys. Rendering in _render() (lines 416-512) uses notification parameter fields directly with no shared state. Test coverage: TestDistinctConcurrentTerminalsBothPost verifies both messages post with correct feature_id. Independent tests confirm no cross-contamination.

Worker pacing implemented with _WORKER_PACING_DELAY = 1.0 (line 69) and asyncio.sleep() after every message delivery (line 368). Test coverage: TestDistinctConcurrentTerminalsBothPost waits 2.5s for two messages confirming ~1s spacing. Independent tests verify pacing behavior.

429 handling in worker loop (lines 307-344) uses attempts_left = _MAX_429_RETRIES + 1 (4 total attempts). SlackApiError with status_code 429 honours Retry-After header (line 326). Budget exhaustion logs slack_429_budget_exhausted WARNING and drops message (lines 338-343), never raises. Test coverage: Test429BackoffHonoursRetryAfter and Test429BudgetExhaustionWarnsAndDrops. Independent tests passed.

Backoff sleep (line 335) occurs inside worker task, not in notify(). notify() uses put_nowait (line 217) ensuring immediate return. Worker continues processing queue after backoff. Test coverage: Test429BackoffHonoursRetryAfter verifies backoff and subsequent delivery; TestNotifyNeverBlocksEventLoop verifies notify() completes < 0.1s even with stalled worker. Independent tests confirm non-blocking behavior.

Queue overflow handling (lines 218-237) catches QueueFull, uses get_nowait() to retrieve oldest message, logs slack_notify_dropped_queue_overflow WARNING once, then put_nowait() enqueues new message. Never blocks (uses nowait methods), never raises (try/except catches and logs). Test coverage: TestOverflowDropsOldestWithOneWarning. Independent tests passed.
